remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Whitney Archive indicates, "Sold to Dole Pineapple Co." Reproduced as advertisement for Dole Pineapple Juice in various publications, such as *Saturday Evening Post* (April 1940) *McCall's* (May 1940); *Vogue* (February 1941). See cat. no. 1925. titles.title: Heliconia

description: The bright red bracts of a crab's claw plant extend outward from its center. These fluted forms have bright green edges, contrasting with the seascape's blue and white tones that form the work's background. A large green leaf fills the left side of the composition.
title: Crab's Claw Ginger Hawaii
